description: Schedule a post to be published at a time, or cancel its schedule. Obriym itself publishes it to every ready channel of the post within about 15 minutes after that time — the AI client does not need to be running then. This is how regular publishing is set up: create several drafts, then schedule each. Needs the owner's "AI may publish to social channels" switch to schedule (see publishingEnabled in list_content_channels); cancelling (scheduledAt: null) does not. A post that is published or being published cannot be scheduled. Returns a warning when no channel of the post is ready yet. Echoes the workspace.

id.description: The publication id returned by create_content_post or list_content_posts.

scheduledAt.description: When to publish, as an ISO 8601 date-time WITH its time-zone offset, e.g. "2026-10-12T10:00:00+03:00". At least one minute and at most one year ahead; list_content_channels returns the workspace time zone. Obriym publishes it itself at that time — no AI client needs to be running. null cancels the schedule and returns the post to a draft.

name: schedule_content_post
title: Schedule post
